name: suvai-canteen-management-system
description: Suvai - Smart Canteen Billing & Management System

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix print-bridge install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build

author: Suvai Development Team
